title: Levelwise invertibility of the integral dualizing comparison
statement: For the finite coefficient extension and coherent dualizing data of [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core], every normalized finite reduction of the canonical comparison u is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the defining reduction equation u_reduction. The target reduction isomorphism, the quotient comparison, the scalar extension of the source reduction, and finiteU are all isomorphisms. IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right cancels the target reduction isomorphism and proves the reduced map itself is an isomorphism at every level.
